assumptions: Events are stored in acquisition order with a time channel.
limits: One file per call; flowAI’s outlier_binsFS and interactive modes are not implemented.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which stretches of this acquisition were unstable, and which events should be removed?

description: Acquisition quality over time by flowAI (flow rate, signal, dynamic range), PeacoQC (peak trajectories, isolation tree, MAD) or flowCut (deviant and low-density segments): events kept, removal per cause per time bin, and the tool’s own table, in raw $TIMESTEP ticks.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

asinh_a.description: the a in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_b.description: the b in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_c.description: the c in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

flowai_remove_from.description: flowAI: which checks remove events. Only applies when tool is flowai.

flowcut_max_perc_cut.description: flowCut MaxPercCut. Only applies when tool is flowcut.

flowcut_max_valley_hgt.description: flowCut MaxValleyHgt. Only applies when tool is flowcut.

flowcut_segment.description: flowCut segment (events). Only applies when tool is flowcut.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

peaco_consecutive.description: PeacoQC consecutive bins. Only applies when tool is peacoqc.

peaco_it_limit.description: PeacoQC isolation tree limit. Only applies when tool is peacoqc.

peaco_mad.description: PeacoQC MAD. Only applies when tool is peacoqc.

tool.description: the method. Values: flowai (flowAI), peacoqc (PeacoQC), flowcut (flowCut).

name: check_flow_cytometry_quality

causes.description: per cause: events flagged, whether it removes, and flagged events per time bin

channels.description: the per-channel table (changepoints, MAD contribution, margins)
